Heavy_Iron_Piston_Arms.description: Forged from iron and bound by ancient sorcery, the Heavy Iron Piston Arms pump with relentless force, their bulk augmenting strength while their ponderous weight hampers agility, granting their wielder the power to lay waste to foes and shatter defenses with devastating blows.

Clockwork_Precision_Manipulators.description: Crafted from intricate gears and polished metal, the Clockwork Precision Manipulators hum with mechanical precision, granting unparalleled agility and finesse in combat while slightly sacrificing brute strength.

Animated_Stone_Bashing_Fists.description: These crude, stone-forged fists are nothing if not relentless, their sturdy appendages granting immense strength and a natural resilience, perfect for reducing foes to rubble and shattering defenses alike.

Mithril_Bladed_Assassin_Arms.description: Forged from the rare and resilient metal mithril, these arms are a blend of arcane enchantment and mechanical precision, enhancing the wielder's dexterity and accuracy in combat, while granting them the lethal skill to inflict bleeding wounds and the agility to perform acrobatic maneuvers.

Living_Wood_Vines_and_Branches.description: Twisting and gnarled, the Living Wood Vines and Branches extend from a construct's limbs, granting them an almost serpentine dexterity and an uncanny ability to scale sheer surfaces with prehensile vines that wrap and coil with a mind of their own.

Crystal_Resonance_Blaster_Arms.description: Equipped with crystalline arms that resonate with arcane energy, this construct possesses a heightened wisdom and unparalleled accuracy, capable of reflecting hostile spells and wielding bursts of radiant light against its foes.

Necrotic_Stitched_Brute_Arms.description: These Necrotic Stitched Brute Arms are a macabre assembly of reanimated flesh and sinew, bound together with blackened stitches and imbued with a weight that suggests they were once part of a formidable creature. Their presence is unsettling, and they grant their bearer immense strength at the cost of charisma, while their skills instill fear and can knock down foes with a single strike.

Steam_Powered_Telescoping_Arms.description: Forged from a blend of brass and steam, these telescoping arms extend and retract with mechanical precision, granting their wielder an extraordinary reach and dexterity that belies their industrial origins.

Scrap_Metal_Claw_Arms.description: Forged from twisted scrap metal and crude mechanical parts, the Scrap Metal Claw Arms are a grotesque yet functional appendage, enhancing raw strength while clumsily reducing precision, their jagged edges capable of inflicting grievous bleeding wounds and allowing the wielder to scavenge the battlefield for more scrap to fuel their relentless advance.

Porcelain_Doll_Jointed_Arms.description: Jointed arms crafted from delicate porcelain, these appendages move with an eerie grace and charm, enhancing the wielder's charisma while paradoxically diminishing their strength, serving as a conduit for the unsettling skill of Lure.
